meta.description: Historical wiring data used by the termigma engine.
meta.sourcing_note: These are the widely published Wehrmacht/Kriegsmarine Enigma I/M3/M4 wiring tables (rotors I-VIII, M4 Beta/Gamma wheels, UKW B/C and their thin M4 counterparts). Cross-checked by reciprocity tests and one published reference test vector (rotors I-II-III, rings 01-01-01, start AAA, reflector B, no plugboard -> "AAAAA" -> "BDZGO"); see tests/test_engine.py. NOT included: verified wiring for Enigma K, Enigma D, Swiss-K, Railway (R/R-Null), Tirpitz (T), Norenigma (N), Sonder-Enigma (S), or the Abwehr G-machines (G-111/G-260/G-312/G-401) - not confidently sourced, and a guess presented as fact would be worse than the gap. The commercial-style preset demonstrates the genuine QWERTZU entry-wheel wiring and lack of a plugboard on commercial machines, but reuses the Enigma I rotor set as a stand-in rather than true K/D rotors.
